shortDescription: Developed Personal Income Tax templates for accountants in the Silverfin platform under a tight deadline
details:
Joined a team of 17 professionals at Silverfin to help deliver Personal Income Tax reporting templates under a time-critical deadline. Working in an unfamiliar domain and a Liquid-based templating language specific to the Silverfin platform, I got up to speed quickly and contributed meaningfully to delivering the project on time.

Responsibilities included developing and maintaining templates, code reviews, and coordinating within a large cross-functional team.
